Package Name: WinRAR ACE Path Traversal Remote Code Execution micropatch
Method of Attack: Absolute Path Traversal vulnerability in UNACEV2.DLL allowing creation of files in arbitrary folders inside or outside destination folder when unpacking ACE archives
Remote Code Execution by exploiting the ACE archive unpacking process
Discoverer: Nadav Grossman from Check Point Software Technologies
Impacted Systems: all products using this particular version of UNACEV2.DLL
Attack Vector: Opening a maliciously crafted ACE archive
